stories.title: NC, PDP blame Centre for lower turnout in second phase of elections in J&K

stories.title: Amit Shah makes Article 370 and security central to Udhampur campaign
stories.summary: At an Udhampur election rally, Union Home Minister Amit Shah said Article 370 would not be restored and framed the vote around preventing a return of terrorism. He attacked Congress leader Rahul Gandhi's position and highlighted that the election was occurring without a separate flag. The supplied campaign report records Shah's claims but does not independently verify their security implications.
stories.why_it_matters: The rhetoric shows how constitutional status and security remain defining electoral dividing lines in Jammu and Kashmir, influencing voter choices beyond immediate local governance concerns.
stories.evidence_status: The Hindu reports Shah's rally statements and political attack; these are attributed campaign claims rather than independent findings about security or opponents.

stories.title: Haryana parties compete for Dalit votes in Assembly election
stories.summary: Political parties in Haryana intensified appeals to Dalit voters, who make up about 21 percent of the electorate, during the reported Assembly campaign. Congress promoted a change message, the BJP sharpened its attacks, and alliances involving the BSP and Azad Samaj Party also sought support. The available report describes campaign positioning rather than a settled shift in voter preference.
stories.why_it_matters: Dalit voters form a large enough bloc to affect close contests across Haryana. Competition among national parties and smaller alliances may shape representation, coalition arithmetic and which social demands receive attention after the election.
stories.evidence_status: The source documents party strategies and the cited electorate share. It does not supply polling or results proving how Dalit voters ultimately divided, so electoral effects remain uncertain.

confidence.rationale: The central development is supported by the named report, while important outcomes or primary records are not fully available.

coverage.rationale: One distinct reporting source supports this selection; broader coverage is not established by the supplied evidence.
